title: Course registration slow during peak window
description: Course registration opened at 08:00. Within four minutes the portal became unusable - pages taking 20-40 seconds, some timing out. There has been no deployment for eleven days. The same window last semester was fine.
deploy_notes:
No application deployments in the last 11 days. Last change: v5.2.0 on 2026-01-09.
Infrastructure change 6 days ago: database instance resized from db.r5.2xlarge to db.r5.xlarge as part of a cost-reduction review. Approved on the basis of average CPU over the previous 30 days (18%).
